title: Launch orchestration: Console dashboard rollouts, release notes, and team enablement
creator: Priya Nair
description: Coordinate cross-functional launch activities for the new Console dashboard panels, rollout controls, and cost breakdown UI. This ticket centralizes release notes copy, stakeholder approvals, support enablement, and a lightweight surge plan for the first 72 hours post-rollout. Key outcomes: clear release notes that map UI changes to API behavior, runbook for fast rollback or partial disable via feature flags, and an internal training plan for Sales/Support/SEs.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical release notes published and linked in Product Releases Confluence page
Support playbook and triage matrix created and reviewed by SRE and Support leads
At least two cross-team rehearsals (eng+design+support+docs) completed and acked
Rollout policy (canary %, time windows, automatic fallback) documented and approved
Training materials (slide deck + short demo recording) uploaded to internal LMS and announced

review_feedback: Design review (Maya): recommend tightening the cost card headings for mobile; adjust truncation rules

rollout_plan_summary: Start with 5% canary in us-west for 4 hours with health checks (errors, latency, anomalous token cost). If stable, ramp to 25% in 2 hours, then 100% across regions after 24 hours. If error rate > 1% or cost anomaly > 30% vs baseline during canary, trigger automatic rollback to previous UI via feature flag and page SRE pager.
training_plan_summary: Two 45-minute rehearsals: (1) internal demo + FAQ for Support and Sales, (2) incident tabletop with SRE and Support using mock faults. Produce a 10-minute demo video and an FAQ one-pager; post to LMS and announce on #console-launch channel.
notes: Decision: we will use feature-flagged rollout rather than an immediate GA to minimize customer risk.
Trade-off: delayed GA increases customer comms complexity but reduces blast radius for regressions; accepted for higher confidence.
Follow-up: collect the first-week metrics (adoption %, average cost per request change, support tickets) and schedule post-mortem on 2026-03-28.
Mitigation: emergency rollback procedure tested in staging on 2026-03-09 — successful with <2 minute rollback time.
